leads.title: Penal Code of 13 August 1980
leads.documents: Criminalization of same-sex sexual activity in Togo; penalty of 1 to 3 years imprisonment and fine of 100,000 to 500,000 CFA francs
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Penal Code of 13 August 1980'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: New Penal Code (2015), Article 393
leads.documents: Revised criminalization phrasing to 'indecent or unnatural act committed with a person of the same sex'; retains 1-3 years imprisonment, increases fine to 1 to 3 million CFA francs
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'In 2015, a new Penal Code was adopted' and 'Article 393'; no URL visible

leads.title: Penal Code, Article 392
leads.documents: Criminalization of LGBTQ advocacy via spoken words, writing, or images perceived as violating public decency; basis for restriction on LGBTQ organizations registering as advocacy organizations
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 392 of the Penal Code'; no URL visible

leads.title: Press and Communications Code (Law 2020-001), Article 5
leads.documents: Defines defamation to include homophobic defamation and prohibits dissemination of defamatory comments and advertising messages
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 5 of the Press and Communications Code (Law 2020-001)'; no URL visible

leads.title: Decree No. 2023-116/PR Relating to the Collection, Transfer, Processing, and use of Passenger Data
leads.documents: Articles 17, 27 and 39 prohibit non-discriminatory passenger screening and protect sexual orientation/sexual life in data processing, including pre-established criteria not based on sexual life or sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 17 of Decree No. 2023-116/PR' plus articles 27 and 39; no URL visible

leads.title: French government website on adoption
leads.documents: States single and married people are eligible to adopt children in Togo; does not say whether LGBTQ people are disqualified
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'According to a website of the French government'; no URL or site name visible
